title: Explainable Risk Attribution with Agent-Based Reasoning
summary: A local-first behavioral trading analysis system that ingests trades, enriches them with market context, and models risk with explainability and chatbot reporting. Its backend risk_distribution module imports GaussianMultivariate from the standalone copulas package to fit a multivariate Gaussian copula over behavioral risk features.
needs: Only the import line was captured; no explicit call site for GaussianMultivariate.fit/sample was shown in the evidence.
